text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first race of the Triple<n>Tiara, the Oka
Sho. But I feel strange...<n>Is it really my destiny to run
in this<n>race?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, whatever. This race will tell<n>me whether I
should focus on miles<n>or take on the 2,400-meter
Japanese<n>Oaks!
